title: CARE and FERA income guidelines
provenance: Human-checked transcription of official public threshold facts, not independent market evidence or model output
interpretation: These synthetic tasks exclude categorical-program qualification and use gross annual household income.
For more than eight people, add the additional-person amount for each extra household member.
At or below the CARE ceiling: CARE likely_eligible, FERA not_primary_path.
Above CARE and at or below FERA: CARE likely_not_eligible_by_income, FERA likely_eligible.
Above both: both likely_not_eligible_by_income. Missing income: both needs_information.
Negative, nonfinite or malformed income is invalid; never silently replace it with zero.
This preliminary screen is never an official enrollment decision. The user must confirm inputs and apply through the utility.
